**Parallel today announced a $2.4 million seed round and shared its goal of giving early-stage companies finance support that pairs software with a fractional CFO—without the cost and complexity of hiring in-house.\
...
**SALT LAKE CITY — October 9, 2025** — **Parallel** today announced a $2.4 million seed round and set out its goal of giving early-stage companies finance support that combines forecasting software with a fractional CFO—without the cost and complexity of hiring in-house.
...
The $2.4 million seed round was led by Night Capital and K5 Tokyo Black, with participation from Penny Jar Capital, Background VC, Mintaka VC, Path Ventures and strategic operators including Jeron Paul (Founder, Spiff), Jared Rodman (Co-founder, Weave), Colin Zima (Founder, Omni) and Alex Bean (Co-founder, Divvy). At the time, the company said the capital would accelerate product development, expand its fractional CFO network, and deepen integrations to keep financial models live and audit ready.
...
This $2.4M seed is just the beginning, and we’re excited to build alongside the next generation of ambitious founders.
